limitations: Resolved life or event dates do not date every town association or imply all offices preceded 565 CE.
Town identity follows explicit crosswalks or native identifiers; Wikidata assertions may still contain source errors or lack references.
Participation and command are associations, not proof of personal presence. Birth, death and burial never substitute for activity.
Text-only Roman-context evidence is labelled in record details.
